result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and Licensor has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” is not required by the playbook and could disrupt the agreed scope or pricing structure. “Without ... other liability” is also unnecessarily broad and could be read to affect accrued obligations rather than merely eliminating an early-termination charge.
